name: Helping Hands
summary: Hurley needs you to help save Curly, who has not returned from his lunch break. He fears there is little time to reach him.

sections.title: Hurley’s Concern
sections.body: Hurley is worried because Curly did not return for lunch. He asks you to go with him and save the missing worker, and fears there is little time. Curly is a good worker despite his foolishness, and Hurley hopes he will recover and learn some sense.

faq.answer: Curly is a worker who has not returned for lunch. Hurley calls him a good worker, though he thinks Curly can be foolish.

faq.q: Who asks for help saving Curly?
faq.answer: Hurley asks you to go with him and save Curly.
Curly did not come back for lunch, and Hurley fears there is little time to save him.

faq.q: What does Hurley hope for Curly?
faq.answer: Hurley hopes Curly heals well and learns some sense.
